review.notes: Full review. The previous pin-lag finding is repaired: the pins are now main's (Tau Ceti 2fd255d9, Mathlib 1b1ccf4b) and the headlines are stated on native mass, classNumber, gramMatrix, determinant, localDensity and e8PowLattice. P2 R01: the indefinite rank>=3 class finiteness of section 0.3 can be stated at the pins (IsIndefinite, IsNondegenerate, genusClasses), but it is absent and the docstring calls it not statable. P3: wrong file for eight_dvd_finrank_of_isEven_isUnimodular_isPosDef (Milgram.lean 381); the Conventions put all class sets under full isometries, but sections 1.1 and 1.4c use proper classes; section 0.0 does not name the native Matrix.isometryMatrices; the Layer 3/4 comment titles do not match the README.
